relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: These results of gain-of-function studies suggest that active MMP-9 in the skin is sufficient to induce neuropathic pain symptoms, macrophage infiltration, and nerve degeneration.

relationships.subject: ab16 anti-MMP-9 mAb
relationships.evidence_quote: ab16 treatment significantly increased PWT and reduced PWF with accumulative effects in db/db mice

key_findings: Selective MMP-9 inhibitory mAbs (ab16, ab29) relieve mechanical and cold pain, restore nerve fiber density and wound healing in diabetic mice.
Active MMP-9 is sufficient to induce pain, macrophage infiltration and nerve degeneration; MMP-9 cleaves pro-TNF-alpha and pro-IL-1beta.
